integrity.analytic_proof: Gram and binary-spin fiber completions; beta integrals; gamma asymptotics
integrity.normalization: 0/1 edge coordinates, one coordinate per edge

limitations: Only the n-triangle common-edge book graph is covered; no general chordal elliptope volume formula is claimed.
The star-suspension cut volume and the n=1 elliptope volume are established prior results.
Unindexed historical derivations under equivalent parameterizations remain possible.
Finite computational tests supplement but do not establish the infinite theorem.
title: Exact edge-gluing volumes for triangular-book graph elliptopes
